sources.title: Independent contextual-bandit weighting, clipping and caller-contract witnesses
sources.author: Causal banking proposal project
supported_claims: Two equal context types give target/IPW7/2, clipped3 and uniform-logger/replay17/4.
Stipulated ten-dollar reward conversion and cost32 give margins3,-2 and10.50.
Correct response regression gives DR population7/2 in the stated law despite clipping.
An invalid probability row sums to one; stochastic target has no exact-one replay matches.
Inert AST confirms selected-array forwarding resolves the apparent tuning flag omission.
